headline: Palantine Berm Quickens as Weathered Expanse Cools Slightly
war_summary: Morning wires since the 03:15 edition put Palantine Berm foremost with three changes in two hours and eleven in the day at Leiri Hermanni and The Droll to 05:33, holdings now six Warden to one Colonial with day losses of 1,728 Colonial and 2,186 Warden and short rates accelerating. The Weathered Expanse eased to two changes in two hours after fifteen in six and thirty-nine in the day around Crow's Nest, Frostmarch and Wightwalk to 04:44, holdings now two Warden, five Colonial and two destroyed with day losses above ten thousand a side. Mooring County stirred anew with three changes in six hours and thirty-five in the day around Gravekeeper's Holdfast, Wiccwalk and The Cut to 03:57, still eleven Warden to one Colonial with day losses above ten thousand a side. Stlican Shelf fell quiet the last two hours after fourteen day changes to 02:34, still four Warden to five Colonial. Callahans Passage and Nevish Line show heavy short losses with accelerating rates but no fresh flips, while Stonecradle, Linn Mercy and Farranac Coast record no new changes.
